Mouse Review Video by Pro Gamer - DeathAdder Chroma, Final Mouse 2015, Zowie ZA11, Steelseries Rival

The mouse hasn't changed significantly in the last 20 years. Every year you're essentially being sold the same tech in new packaging. The only real change is that battery life in the wireless devices has become better.

actually, the change from laser to optical was a real game changer. and the new "flawless" sensor is pretty freaking amazing.

although i dislike the trend of overly bells and whistled, heavy, janky, hard, edgy, ambidexterous, gimmicky and such.

which is why i love the "Mionix Naos 7000" :3 it's as ergonomic as a good ol logitech revolution mx, and still has top of the line software (that you don't have to login to.... fuck razer), as well as a "PixArt PMW 3310DH" flawless sensor :3 (oh also, really fucking lightweight, as lightweight as finalmouse or a zowie, and as nice, non sticky feet, both things making it good for fast twitchy movements, no acceleration or angle snapping :3). also, glad the dpi buttons are in a concave place, not obscuring anything, likewise with the page forward/back buttons :P (btw, same reason i dislike ambidexterous, apart from them being janky and un-ambidexterous as hell- buttons that you can accidentally and easily press with your resting pinkie and ring fingers...) scroll wheel could have a "click this to rapid spin", but whatever :P durable/reliable as well.

also, glad it doesn't have a sniper button, it fucks with your muscle memory, distracts, fills, and you're better off learning to aim with a mouse with good polling rate (more important than dpi/cpi)

oh also, braided chords fray alot, too bad there's not a durable bendable alternative to plastic.. oh well, the friction/weight as well.

also, i dislike purely wireless mice, wireless mice has major delay (which can be worse, unless you have a monitor, al a, a benq with 1ms delay+n-sync/freesync(depending on if you have an amd or nvidia graphics card) anti screen tearing panel, and is running a high end game), wired mouse is pretty much instant, as well as more precise, and doesn't have to take a break to recharge, with worsening battery life.

... btw, surface is alpha omega as well, i'd suggest something like the "steelseries qck+" mousepad, or "Zowie G-SR" mousepad. cloth wears down less than hard surface, and are more precise.

also, different purposes, different mice. rts, moba, fps, mmo, rpg. etcetera.
